title.en: Optica Egypt Local Section Officially Approved

summary.en: Optica officially approved the charter of the Optica Egypt Local Section on 10 September 2026, establishing a formal national section dedicated to advancing photonics education, research collaboration, and industry partnership across Egypt.

title.en: Student Chapter Expansion Initiative Launched with AUC Chapter

summary.en: Optica Egypt convened its first cross-university coordination meeting with the Chartered Student Chapter at The American University in Cairo (AUC), setting a nationwide roadmap to charter new chapters at Cairo University, Ain Shams University, and Alexandria University.

title.en: Open Source Silicon Photonics Design Track Announced for 2026

summary.en: In partnership with regional laboratories, Optica Egypt unveiled the Open Source Photonics track, providing Egyptian engineering students and researchers with open PDK design kits, gdsfactory training, and preparation for multi-project wafer (MPW) fabrication runs.
